about: #24's matrix (interaction-contract.md, Responsive): each surface's default point, the widths it's also checked at, and the points that change one axis from the default on every surface. Widths are CSS px, zoom is a percentage, and fontSize is the profile's default font size in px. Zoom Z at width W is a W/Z CSS px viewport at deviceScaleFactor Z, and Popup at zoom Z is min(maxWidth, width x Z)/Z CSS px wide. Dark is gated against its ownerGate entries.
